description: Friction test (Stage C1), XPBD: the 10 cm block starts resting on the ground and sliding at 1 m/s along +x. Coulomb friction mu = 0.3 should stop it after v^2 / (2 mu g) = 17 cm, in v / (mu g) = 0.34 s. Same material as drop_xpbd_volume.json (edge compliance 1/300, volume compliance 1e-6, 50 substeps).
